issues.exact_new_text: Payments in vouchers, cheques, cards or vales. Res. 227 art. 1.3.7.1.1 para. 6 imposes a HARD EXCLUSION: 'El valor reportado en el numeral 7, no debe contener la informacion reportada en los demas numerales del Formato 2276'. It is a residual concept, and double-reporting it against numerals 5, 8 or 17 is a validation failure. Meal payments to a third party for an employee whose monthly salary exceeds 310 UVT (COP 16,235,940 in 2026) are reported HERE, because the ET art. 387-1 exclusion does not apply to that employee (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025, element pabop); for an employee whose monthly salary does not exceed 310 UVT the same payment is split at 41 UVT between numeral 32 (element pagahuvt) and numeral 8 (element vaex) and nothing comes here. The 310-UVT test is applied month by month.
